glossary.entries.tick.body.0: One step of the world: each tick the line carries one bit and the board computes once.
glossary.entries.tick.title: tick
glossary.groups.line.title: The line
level.1-1.intro.0.t: The line carries one bit each tick: 0 or 1.
level.1-1.tasks.1-1.brief: Give the bit on the line, every tick.
level.1-1.tasks.1-1.outputs.0.label: Bit
level.1-1.title: Listen
level.1-2.after: A register lets a circuit remember the tick before.
level.1-2.intro.0.t: The board computes afresh every tick and keeps nothing once done. To keep a value for the next tick there is a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.
level.1-2.tasks.1-2.brief: Every tick, say on the line what the input was the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.
level.1-2.tasks.1-2.inputs.0.label: Bit
level.1-2.title: A tick late
piece.const.desc: Always gives the number it is set to.
piece.const.name: Constant
piece.keep.desc: Stores its input in the register of the same name; it can be read from the next tick on.
piece.keep.name: Keep
piece.reg.desc: Gives the value held in the register of the same name; before anything is stored, gives its start value (「—」 or the number set).
piece.reg.name: Register
piece.keep.settings.reg.label: Name
piece.const.settings.value.label: Value
piece.reg.settings.reg.label: Name
piece.reg.settings.start.label: Start
